seo.title: Comparisons | Steps AI
seo.description: Honest comparisons of Steps AI with Manychat, Wati, AiSensy, Gorgias, Chatbase, Verifast and Tidio.

hero.title: Compare Steps AI with the tools you are considering.
hero.body: Each comparison covers channels, order lookups and pricing model, and says plainly when the other tool is the better choice.
hero.reassurance: Plain comparisons. Where we fit. Where we do not.

cards.label: vs. Manychat
cards.body: Manychat is known for building automated flows on Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger.

cards.label: vs. Wati
cards.body: Wati is a WhatsApp Business platform for broadcasts, team inboxes and chatbot flows.

cards.label: vs. AiSensy
cards.body: AiSensy is a WhatsApp marketing platform that many Indian brands use for broadcasts and campaigns.

cards.label: vs. Gorgias
cards.body: Gorgias is a Shopify helpdesk with AI automation added on.

cards.label: vs. Chatbase
cards.body: Chatbase builds an AI chatbot from your website and documents.

cards.label: vs. Verifast
cards.body: Verifast and Steps AI both lead with helping shoppers choose and buy.

cards.label: vs. Tidio
cards.body: Tidio is a live chat tool with an AI assistant, Lyro, offered as an upgrade.

cta.title: Bring your own questions to a demo.
cta.body: We will run them through Steps AI so you can compare for yourself.
